question: On the consumed 3RScan pairwise-retrieval failure, does the parameter-free closed-roster assignment repair sibling-door collisions without changing embeddings or pair scores?

mechanism.pair_score: Reuse the predecessor baseline and frozen center-scale scores exactly.
mechanism.assignment: For each 3x3 matrix, maximize total score under a one-reference-to-one-query constraint with scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment. No score weight, threshold or identity feature is added.
mechanism.diagnostics: Report independent directed Top-1, assigned identity count, equivalent bidirectional identity count and the gap to the second-best complete assignment.

claim_boundary: This is post-hoc mechanism Development on an already consumed three-target cohort. A positive repair can motivate a successor but is not confirmation. It assumes a complete closed one-to-one roster and is not open-set retrieval, detection, entrance ownership, access, traversability, arrival, handoff, user-benefit or mobility-safety evidence.
